name: Business English
description: Professional English: meetings, presentations, emails, negotiation, introductions.
system_prompt: The conversation topic for this session is professional and business English. Guide conversation around workplace scenarios: introducing yourself professionally, discussing a project or presentation, negotiating, giving feedback, writing professional emails, or navigating workplace dynamics. Use professional vocabulary but keep the tone approachable.
starter_questions: Can you give me a quick professional introduction of yourself — as if you were meeting a new colleague or client for the first time?
Imagine you need to present your current project or work to a senior manager in 2 minutes. What's the key message?
Have you ever had to give or receive critical feedback at work? How did you handle it?
